description: This file defines a React hook and utility functions for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It includes createProgressiveExpandController for batch processing and useProgressiveExpand hook for React component integration.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches asynchronously, with progress callbacks and cancel capability.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing using createProgressiveExpandController.
